verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents a session supervisor for 'background workers and agent runtimes that must outlive an SDK call', plus pause/resume with auto_resume so inbound access can wake a paused sandbox, and Sandbox Functions that serve HTTP handlers without a long-lived server. Together these give background agents a durable execution substrate and a basic event-driven wake path. However, there is no first-party way to define an automation: no scheduler, cron, or trigger configuration. GitHub Actions orchestration is an external CI workaround and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: native scheduling/cron or trigger-based automation setup, an automation definition and management workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of long-running background operation.
